scope: Local macOS arm64; isolated database and real public Store entry points under an explicitly retained shared Store mutex; no live accounts or deployment
problem: Public task paths captured Unix time before awaiting the Store mutex/SQLite transaction. Authority that expired while queued could still authorize a read, binding/grant insert or task message.

baseline.result: 1 test failed: all 7 scenarios accepted expired authority; registration, provider/local issuance and invocation message committed mutations. Read/authentication snapshots remained unchanged but returned obsolete authority.

correction: Public task execution, invocation execution, registration, grant issuance and authentication sample the current clock only after serialized transaction admission. Fixed clocks remain private unit-test inputs. Grant format, scope, receipts and schema do not change.

intermediate_verification.result: 149 Store unit tests passed, including all seven real blocked-expiry scenarios; zero failures/ignores

retained_attempts.result: Initial fixture compilation rejected a nonexistent Store clone and missing Invoke fields. Corrected shared Arc ownership and explicit fields before behavioral baseline.
Strict Clippy rejected an unused private fixed-clock authentication helper after current-clock routing changed. Removed unused code; no lint suppression.

closure: G4-008 requirements are audited in task-authority-audit.json; no integrated A4 criterion or full Gate 4 closure is inferred.
